page_title: RambleFix - AI-enhanced writing that sounds like you

sources.entry: Ramblefix - Speak and interact with AI.

summary.name: RambleFix
summary.one_liner: RambleFix is an AI tool that turns rambling voice notes into polished emails, notes, summaries, and posts, dictated into any app.
use_cases: drafting emails from voice after a call
capturing meeting minutes and action items
turning rough ideas into blog draft paragraphs
writing social media posts by voice
crafting AI prompts from spoken requests
summary.what_it_does: RambleFix records or takes spoken input and produces cleaned-up written text, removing filler words and false starts. Users dictate with a hotkey into any Mac app, and the polished text appears at the cursor. The same recording can yield summaries, action items, and meeting notes. The page also describes transcribing uploaded audio into a timestamped transcript. It is available on web, iPhone, and Mac, with a free tier of 1,000 words per month on Mac and web.
notable: Hotkey dictation into any Mac app, with polished text inserted at the cursor
Compares itself to built-in dictation: cleans up fillers and produces summaries and action items
States audio is deleted right after transcription and not used to train AI
caveats: Free tier is limited to 1,000 words per month, on Mac and web; more usage requires an upgrade
Testimonials and use-case quotes are marketing claims rather than independently verified facts
